ModMetaData.name: RimWorld FPS Mode
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld FPS Mode contributors (fork of RimWorld x MW2 by rkwitz)
ModMetaData.description: Play your colonists in first person with RimWorld's own art. Select a colonist and turn on "FPS mode". The FPS client comes with the mod (Windows and Linux) and starts by itself with RimWorld; the dot in the top right corner is green while it is online. Fork of RimWorld x MW2 by rkwitz.
